landingTitle: Send every link where it needs to go.
landingDescription: Turn long URLs into short, trackable labels. Create from the dashboard or API, then read the clicks without the noise.
landingFeatures: A short route. The full context stays.
landingFeaturesDescription: Every short link remains editable, measurable, and available from the same workflow—whether you work in the dashboard or in a script.
controllableLinksDescription: Custom slugs, an editable destination, active state, and expiry. Redis serves the fast redirect; PostgreSQL remains the source of truth.
readableAnalyticsDescription: Account overview and link detail: clicks over time, sources, countries, and automatic click milestones in one operational view.
advertisingRedirectsDescription: Optionally show an AdsTerra interstitial with a visible-only countdown, then reveal Continue to site or redirect automatically.
firstClassApiDescription: Create and manage links through a versioned API, with revocable keys and read or write permissions.
sameProduct: From dashboard to script, without changing product.
sameProductDescription: Use the interface to work at a glance. When automation is needed, copy the same operation into the API.
nextLinkReady: Your next link is ready to move.
nextLinkDescription: Configure the account, create the slug, and watch the first clicks arrive.
invalidDestination: Enter a web address, for example example.com/page.
checkKeys: Revocable keys with read or write scopes
checkMcp: OpenAPI spec and an MCP endpoint at /api/mcp
